$comment: Self-guard for authoring THIS plugin repo. Read by the plugin's own installed nothing_loose PreToolUse hook via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR when a session is rooted here (dogfooding — see CLAUDE.md 'Safe-edit protocol'). FAILS OPEN if absent. The installed/cache copy of the hook is what fires; editing hook source here is inert until `claude plugin update`, so this guard cannot lock you out. allow_write = globs where the agent may Write/Edit; a NEW loose file elsewhere is denied. Add a path here if the repo grows a new top-level location.
